findings.body: The confirmed spec requires collecting commands from a fixed module list, but the supplied COLLECTOR contract requires discovery through `pkgutil` without a fixed list. Following the spec would require another shared-file edit whenever a command introduces a module, contradicting its own acceptance criterion at lines 61–62. Update this requirement and the corresponding read-note disposition to match the agreed discovery contract.
findings.title: Replace fixed module discovery with the agreed automatic discovery

findings.body: The spec assigns the CI workflow to the init module, while the supplied SHIPS contract assigns it to `prcheck.py` and excludes `init.py` from that task's scope. It also names a skill module instead of the agreed `story.py` owner for the Forge skill and FDE page. These conflicting instructions should be reconciled in the spec so the implementation can follow the confirmed ownership and task boundaries.
findings.title: Align shipped-file owners with the agreed SHIPS contract

findings.body: This part permits only the two spec files and `plans/roadmap.json`, but the diff also adds this parent-story plan, its read notes, `.factory/stories/FORGE-SPLIT-1/story.json`, and the task JSON under that story.
